summary: Phase 3 frontend re-verification. Both HIGH-priority frontend fixes are confirmed working. FIX #1 (white-on-white synthesis): all body rows now render with color rgb(10,10,11) on rgb(255,255,255) white synthCard background — 'Resolution:', bullet 'Conditions:', 'Escalate to human:', and 'Synthesizer confidence: 90%' are fully readable, with green synthK labels (rgb(14,122,42)) as designed. FIX #2 (debate-box on revisit): on FIRST load of /note/fe261fcd-0d6f-41de-a80c-df5dc1ee23e6 (no Convene click), both data-testid='debate-box' and data-testid='synthesis-proposal' render immediately from GET /notes/{id}/debate/latest — REJECTED badge shows, all 3 turns and synthesis card visible. FIX #3 (backend novel_decision downweight): verified in code at /app/backend/server.py:350-355 — should_debate = (any non-novel_decision trigger present) OR (>=2 triggers total). Regression: after clicking Convene on the same note, 5 consensus verdicts render (UNCERTAIN score 1.41), debate-triggers card renders with 5 chips, and debate-box + synthesis-proposal persist alongside consensus — the ternary refactor (siblings out of the !consensus gate) did not break the consensus branch.

rca_of_issue: N/A — both bugs resolved. FIX #1 root cause was a shared debateRow style used across a dark parent (debateBox) and a white child (synthCard); mitigation was a dedicated synthRow with color #0A0A0B. FIX #2 root cause was JSX gating debate rendering inside the else branch of {!consensus ? placeholder : consBox}; mitigation was hoisting the triggers/debate-btn/debate-box blocks out of the ternary so they render whenever their own state is populated, independent of consensus.
